ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible ventral surface consists of approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels and 35% high-intensity (yellowish-white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe contains a large, irregular yellowish-white central region extending towards the trailing edge. Left lobe contains a smaller, localized yellowish-white patch near the water line. Both are surrounded by thick, contiguous black borders at the periphery.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with a pixel-estimated interior angle of approximately 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right trailing edge displays distinct serrations with 6-8 visible peaks, most prominent near the distal tip. Left trailing edge is largely occluded by water spray and foam.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe trailing edge follows a convex curve from the median notch to a pointed, slightly recurved (hooked) tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of approximately five circular light-colored ring-like clusters on the right lobe surface; one isolated circular ring is visible on the left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, horizontal white linear mark (~80-100 pixels in length) on the upper-distal quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular barnacle attachment scars and at least one distinct linear rake mark on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan tint in the non-pigmented central areas, distinct from pure white foam in the foreground.
